# Bundled Arabic font
Noto Sans Arabic variable width/weight font, unmodified, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansarabic
File: NotoSansArabic[wdth,wght].ttf
SHA-256: 63111b5b2e074dd48cc67692e0a2726d86ee94c1c37fe8598257b7b4e87e869e
Included as app/src/main/res/font/noto_sans_arabic.ttf. License is also packaged in assets/licenses.
Native Android shaping and bidi; no font download at runtime or custom Arabic reversal.
